gaps.what: No page opened dates the 1111 northern strip (Behesni, Hisn Mansur), the 1126 growth to 39.8 E, or the acquisition of Samosata, Saruj and Aintab; recorded as confidence-1 gains.
Which places went to Mesud, Timurtash of Mardin and Nur ad-Din in 1150-1151, and whether Byzantine garrisons actually held Turbessel after the 1150 sale.
Kayseri and the west to Dorylaeum/Afyon (1188 shape), Kastamonu and the Antalya-Erzurum reach of the 1202 shape, and the 1086-1093 extent are not dated by any page opened.
Abbasid allegiance 1202-1249 (Cliopatria relation) not confirmed; no event written. Open 'Al-Nasir' or 'Abbasid Caliphate'.
1260-1304 Cliopatria has no shape; the nominal sultanate is drawn as the 1305 core at confidence 1, and the Mongol vassalage (1243, 1256) needs vassal_start events in mongol-empire/ilkhanate (ia-02).
Whether the Ayyubid cities of 1234 (Siverek, Urfa, Harran, Raqqa) and the Diyarbakir region of 1237 were held or only raided.
The west coast 1225-1260 (Rum, Cilicia and Karamanid pages disagree) and the 30.6 E reach of the 1192 shape; Gaban and Hajin missing from the 1260-1304 shapes.
Lands ceded after Mari (1266) and in the 1285 truce, the annexation of Hromgla (1292), Ayas (1337) and Silifke are not named or dated by any page opened.
Rulers strip omitted: the Cilicia page's table lacks end dates and disagrees with the Hethum I page.
